title: Flash Gordon
tagline: Ming is merciless. Dinner is not.
about: A football star crash lands on the planet Mongo and takes on Ming the Merciless.

    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersPanko chicken bites with honey mustardFootball-shaped panko chicken pieces with a honey Dijon dipping sauceHow to make it600g chicken thighs, diced50g plain flour2 eggs, beaten100g panko breadcrumbs3 tbsp oil3 tbsp honey2 tbsp Dijon mustardPress the chicken into small oval football shapes.Coat in flour, egg and panko.Shallow fry in the oil until golden and cooked through.Mix the honey with the Dijon for dipping and pile the footballs on a platter.Hawkmen sky city wingsBaked wings in a sticky honey, soy and chilli glaze with sesameHow to make it1kg chicken wings1 tsp salt3 tbsp honey3 tbsp soy sauce1 red chilli, sliced1 tbsp sesame seeds, toastedToss the wings with salt and bake at 220°C until crisp.Warm the honey, soy and chilli until sticky.Toss the wings through the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds.Arboria forest stuffed mushroomsPrince Barin's forest moon of ArboriaHow to make itAs written, serves 4Flat mushrooms packed with garlic butter, crisp bacon, breadcrumbs, parmesan and parsley, baked until golden and bubbling, finished with lemon.Remove the stems from 8 flat mushrooms and chop them.Fry 100g diced bacon until crisp, add the stems and 2 garlic cloves and cook 2 minutes.Mix with 60g breadcrumbs, 40g grated parmesan, chopped parsley and 40g melted butter.Pile into the mushroom caps and bake at 200°C for 12 minutes until golden.Squeeze over lemon to serve.MainsZarkov's rocket fuel curryRed curry prawns with coconut milk, red capsicum and Thai basil. Fuel for the rocket shipHow to make it2 tbsp red curry paste1 tbsp oil600g green prawns, peeled400ml coconut milk1 red capsicum, sliced1 cup Thai basil leaves300g jasmine riceFry the curry paste in the oil until fragrant. Add the prawns and brown.Pour in the coconut milk and simmer, adding the capsicum for the last 5 minutes.Cook the rice. Stir the Thai basil through the curry and serve with the rice.Ming's red banquet beef filletMing's planned wedding to DaleHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef eye fillet roasted to medium rare and sliced on a long platter with roasted red onions, beetroot and a rich, glossy red wine and thyme sauce.Roast 4 beetroot wrapped in foil at 200°C for 1 hour, then peel and cut into wedges.Halve 4 red onions and roast with oil and balsamic for 40 minutes.Sear a 1kg eye fillet on all sides and roast at 220°C for 20 minutes to medium rare, then rest.Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml beef stock and thyme until glossy and whisk in 20g butter.Slice and arrange on a long platter.SweetsMongo red and gold trifleSponge, raspberry jelly, mango, custard and cream with gold sprinklesHow to make it1 sponge cake, cubed1 packet raspberry jelly crystals2 mangoes, sliced500ml custard300ml thickened cream, whipped1 tbsp gold sprinklesPress the sponge cubes into a glass bowl. Make up the jelly following the packet and pour over.Chill until set.Layer with sliced mango, custard and whipped cream. Chill overnight.Finish with gold sprinkles just before serving.DrinksPrincess Aura's red punchPomegranate and cranberry juice with soda and lime over ice, no alcoholHow to make it500ml pomegranate juice500ml cranberry juice1 L cold soda water2 limes, cut into wedges1 bag iceFill tall glasses with ice. Pour in equal parts pomegranate and cranberry juice to about halfway.Top with soda water, squeeze in a wedge of lime and stir once. Serve straight away.
